_meta.about: Numbers for heal items that have no wiki article, laid over the designed frame by server/items.py exactly the way a data/items_wiki.json record is (same keys, frame shape unchanged). A wiki record, where one exists, wins. DESIGNED, NOT RECOVERED: the original server kept these numbers and they are lost. Each record says in _designed what was chosen and in _source what is real.
_meta.decided: 2026-09-23, owner: trader Морис (5211) sells medicine for character levels 0-8, i.e. the level bands 0_3, 4_7 and 8_11, in every variant (A/P/G); the 20-dose packs take the single injector's numbers with 20 uses at 20 times the price; the (P) kits between Мини and Стандарт are interpolated.
_meta.fields: ss_si_heal names as in server/items.py; g_cost in hundredths of G (0.01 G = 1), like items_wiki.json; need_skills_m/need_skills as Item.parseNeedBonus reads them (bit 2 = Медицина). Keys starting with _ never reach the wire.
